t: The Magnusson Green Self-Levelling Cross-Line Laser Level is a robust tool designed for precise alignment tasks. It projects bright green horizontal and vertical laser lines, offering a 30-metre working range without a receiver, making it ideal for professional tiling, accurate shelving installation, and framing work. With an accuracy of ± 0.3mm/m, this self-levelling laser ensures reliable measurements. Its IP54 rating provides dust and splash protection for indoor and outdoor use, and the integrated USB-C rechargeable battery offers convenient power on site. Also supplied with a magnetic stand, a target plate and a carry bag.
